Definition: properly, the fore part; used adverbially, opposite
BiblicalUsage: Israel camps over against Baal-zephon before the sea, and the worshipper who enters by the north gate goes out by the south, standing before the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe standing before the LORD is the whole of worship: Israel faces the sea with Egypt behind her, and the worshipper faces God with the gate behind him, and neither one can go back the way he came.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
